sentences.text: "The present writ petition has been filed impugning Exts.P3 and P4 revenue recovery notices issued in pursuance to the award passed by the Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal, Ottapalam in O.P.(M.V.) No.611/2018.
The petitioner has filed an appeal against the said award, which is pending.
2. If the petitioner has any remedy against the impugned notices, the petitioner has to move to Appellate Court and not before this Court.
Therefore, I find no substance in this writ petition.

Thus,
the present writ petition is hereby dismissed."

2024:KER:70020 2. Aggrieved by the said judgment, the petitioner has filed this appeal under Section 5(i) of the Kerala High Court Act, 1958.
3.
Heard the learned counsel for the appellant and the learned Senior Government Pleader.
4. Ext.P1(a) is the award in OP(MV) No.611 of 2018.

The Tribunal allowed the said original petition ordering the insurer to pay compensation and allowing the insurer to recover the amount of compensation from the appellant, who was the 1st respondent in the OP(MV).
As a sequel to the said award, the recovery proceedings were initiated against the appellant.
Ext.P2 is the revenue recovery certificate issued by the District Collector in the above regard.
The 2 nd respondent issued notice under Section 7 of the Revenue Recovery Act, 1968 to the appellant.
It was at that juncture the appellant filed the writ petition.
5. MACA No.2392 of 2024 was filed by the appellant challenging Ext.P1(a) award.
It is seen that there was delay in filing the appeal.
That might be the reason for occurring some 2024:KER:70020 delay in considering the said appeal.

When such an appeal has been filed and the appellant has the remedy of getting operation of the impugned award stayed during the pendency of the appeal, he cannot invoke the extraordinary jurisdiction of this Court under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.

6. In Bihar Eastern Gangetic Fishermen Cooperative Society Ltd. v. Sipahi Singh [(1977) 4 SCC 145],
a Three-Judge Bench of the Apex Court held that a writ of mandamus can be granted only in a case where there is a statutory duty imposed upon the officer concerned and there is a failure on the part of that officer to discharge the statutory obligation.

entities.text: Bihar Eastern Gangetic Fishermen Cooperative Society Ltd. v. Sipahi Singh [(1977) 4 SCC 145]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The chief function of a writ is to compel performance of public duties prescribed by statute and to keep subordinate tribunals and officers exercising public functions within the limit of their jurisdiction.

7. In Oriental Bank of Commerce v. Sunder Lal Jain [(2008) 2 SCC 280] the Apex Court held that in order that a writ of mandamus may be issued, there must be a legal right with the party asking for the writ to compel the 2024:KER:70020 performance of some statutory duty cast upon the authorities.

entities.text: Oriental Bank of Commerce v. Sunder Lal Jain [(2008) 2 SCC 280]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In the said decision, the Apex Court noticed that the principles on which a writ of mandamus can be issued have been stated in 'The Law of Extraordinary Legal Remedies' by F. G.
Ferris and F. G. Ferris, Jr. that, mandamus is, subject to the exercise of a sound judicial discretion,
Johnson K.T vs United India Insurance Company Ltd on 11 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88961641/
3 the appropriate remedy to enforce a plain, positive, specific and ministerial duty presently existing and imposed by law upon officers and others who refuse or neglect to perform such duty, when there is no other adequate and specific legal remedy and without which there would be a failure of justice.
8. In State of U.P. v. Harish Chandra [(1996) 9 SCC 309] the Apex Court held that under the Constitution a mandamus can be issued by the Court when the applicant establishes that he has a legal right to performance of legal duty by the party against whom the mandamus is sought and said right was subsisting on the date of the petition.

sentences.text: The duty that may be enjoined by mandamus may be one imposed by the Constitution or a Statute or by Rules or orders having the 2024:KER:70020 force of law.
But no mandamus can be issued to direct the Government to refrain from enforcing the provisions of law or to do something which is contrary to law.
9. In the light of the law laid down in the aforesaid decisions, the view taken by the learned Single Judge cannot be said to be incorrect.
Hence, we find no reason to interfere with the impugned judgment.
The appeal fails and it is accordingly dismissed.
